classic_self_samimiyet_01: I always build natural, sincere, and warm relationships with people in new environments.
classic_self_cekicilik_01: I am an attractive person who stands out in any environment with my style, aura, and appearance.
classic_self_zeka_01: I am very good at finding quick solutions to complex problems and noticing details others miss.
classic_self_vizyon_01: Instead of daily matters, I focus on general knowledge, art, and long-term plans for the future.
classic_self_enerji_01: I bring high energy to my surroundings, lift the mood of the room, and initiate plans.
classic_self_guvenilirlik_01: I keep secrets under all circumstances and never let my friends down.
classic_self_ego_01: Due to my high self-confidence and distant stance, I may sometimes appear proud or aloof from the outside.
classic_self_basari_01: I am highly ambitious about my life goals; I always deliver high-standard results in my work or education.
classic_self_comertlik_01: I never calculate or hesitate when sharing my resources, time, or belongings with my friends.
classic_self_olgunluk_01: Instead of reacting emotionally to difficult situations and crises, I always act calm and mature.
classic_friend_samimiyet_01: This person always behaves sincerely and warmly towards others, without any pretension.
classic_friend_cekicilik_01: This person has an attractive aura, drawing attention in every environment with their style, charisma, and appearance.
classic_friend_zeka_01: This person's mind works very quickly and efficiently; they always find practical solutions during crises.
classic_friend_vizyon_01: This person has a visionary character, inspiring others with their knowledge, ideas, and outlook on life.
classic_friend_enerji_01: This person is the source of joy in any environment; when they arrive, the group's energy rises immediately.
classic_friend_guvenilirlik_01: This person is a reliable character you can trust completely, keeps secrets, and always keeps their word.
classic_friend_ego_01: This person sometimes exhibits an arrogant, distant, and superior attitude towards others.
classic_friend_basari_01: This person is a determined profile with well-planned career and life goals, set for success.
classic_friend_comertlik_01: This person is extremely open-handed and generous when sharing or spending in a group.
classic_friend_olgunluk_01: This person always displays a calm, logical, and mature stance relative to their age during unexpected crises.
